comment: Custom boutique amp + cabinet + Neve-style coloration for the Zoom MultiStomp. Original DSP (not a stock clone), strict real-amp structure (v15): V1 fixed ~4x gain + Miller LP @9k -> V2 cold clipper (Gain + touch dynamics) + Miller LP @5k -> Klon-style clean/dirty mix -> tone network Bass/Mid/Treble -> phase inverter + push-pull power stage with sag (Master) -> Neve transformer even harmonics + 1073-style EQ (Neve, wet/dry) -> speaker resonance + cabinet (Cab dark..bright, Presence) -> Level. Nine knobs, three pages x three, mirroring the VST: P1 Bass/Mid/Treble, P2 Gain/Master/Level, P3 Neve/Cab/Presence. Params persist with the pedal patch (save the patch to remember the settings).
gid_comment: 0x04 = AMP category. SONAME prefix becomes ZDL_AMP_.
fxid_comment: 0x01A4 in the custom effect range (above stock).

params.name: Bass
params.comment: Tone-network low control, tight 140 Hz (0.5 = flat).

params.name: Mid
params.comment: Tone-network mid presence at 850 Hz (0.5 = flat).

params.name: Treble
params.comment: Tone-network high control at 5 kHz (0.5 = flat).

params.name: Gain
params.comment: V2 cold-clipper drive + touch-dynamics base (soft = clean, hard = crunch).

params.name: Master
params.comment: PI + push-pull power drive + sag amount.

params.name: Neve
params.comment: Neve coloration amount: transformer even harmonics + 1073 EQ wet/dry (0 = bypass).

params.name: Presence
params.comment: Speaker 3.5 kHz resonance amount (0 = off, 1 = full).

params.name: Voice
params.comment: Voice: 0 = Nashville session, 1 = Emo/Edge (earlier breakup, more 400-800 Hz body, warmer top, less Neve sheen).
